acquisition_policy.formula: acq(x) = EI(x; xi) + 0.3 * max(thompson_sample(x) - f_best, 0), where thompson_sample(x) ~ N(mu(x), sigma(x)^2) and mu(x) = m(x) + mu_res(x)
acquisition_policy.surrogate_mean: m(x) = calibrated biophysical prior; the GP is fitted on residuals y - m(x)
acquisition_policy.batch_construction: k-DPP diversity selection over the Pareto-filtered candidate pool; candidates are enumerated from the strategy's clusters and lead recombinants, capped at 3 mutations

overrides_passed_by_the_benchmark.numpy_global_seed: (seed * 7919 + round_index) % (2**31 - 1), seeded by the caller because the Thompson draw uses numpy's global RNG

qualify_minimum_set_floor.note: No minimum-qualifying-set floor is applied. At the default quantile the qualifying set is ONE variant on the CR6261 landscapes, which makes qualification equivalent to finding the global best; see qualify_qualifying_count. Applying a floor is a protocol decision that must be taken in advance, not resolved silently by the benchmark.

label_provenance.definition: A historical dataset whose records cannot be separated into measured and imputed. The universe is known to contain both and no per-record flag exists, so no individual label can be claimed as measured.

vocabulary.HISTORICAL_MEASURED: A value physically measured in a previously published or previously run experiment, and identified as measured by the dataset itself (a provenance column) or by an external list of the records that were not measured.
vocabulary.HISTORICAL_IMPUTED: A value filled in by a model from neighbouring records in a historical dataset - for the TrpB landscape, the scikit-learn KNN imputer the authors used. Not a measurement.
vocabulary.HISTORICAL_UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE: A historical dataset whose records cannot be separated into measured and imputed. The universe is known to contain both and no per-record flag exists, so no individual label can be claimed as measured.
vocabulary.SIMULATED_NOISY_OUTCOME: A generated value from a simulator or synthetic landscape. Useful for validating mechanism; says nothing about biological performance.
vocabulary.PROSPECTIVE_PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT: A value measured physically after this system selected the variant - the only kind that supports a prospective claim. No run in this benchmark produces one.
vocabulary.MODEL_PREDICTION: A model's own prediction (for example an ESM pseudo-likelihood) used in place of an outcome. Never comparable with a measurement.

Do NOT assume that because every method searches the same contaminated universe the comparison between methods is unbiased. The contamination is not independent of the methods: the published KNN-imputed values sit wherever sequencing coverage was poorest, which is not uniform over the landscape. If imputed records cluster in the region one method prefers to explore, that method is scored against model output while another is scored against measurements, and the bias is DIFFERENTIAL, not common-mode. Nothing in this run bounds that effect, and no shared-universe argument removes it.

assay.transformation: declared 'none'; this benchmark applies none of its own - the prepared table's DMS_score column is the objective verbatim, never re-scaled, log-transformed, standardised or clipped here
assay.replicates: unknown: the prepared table carries one value per variant, so no replicate aggregation or measurement-noise model is applied

censoring.policy: values at a declared limit keep their measured value and are COUNTED, not adjusted or dropped. A mass of ties at the floor is a detection limit, not a plateau, and a model treating them as exact continuous labels is mis-specified

label_policy.policy: absent label, measured zero and detection floor are three distinct states; only labelled rows enter the eligible universe, and each excluded row is checked against the declared placeholder so a real measurement cannot be discarded as an absent label

threshold_definition.statistic: percentile of measured fitness over the eligible set of this run
threshold_definition.tie_handling: fitness >= threshold counts as a hit; all ties count, so the hit set can exceed 1% of the pool
threshold_definition.scope: recomputed per run over the eligible set; a different eligibility filter changes the threshold
threshold_definition.visibility: evaluator-only; never passed to a selector or into candidate metadata

measurement_budget.accounting: unique variants only; duplicate, already-observed, unknown and over-budget selections are rejected, and a short batch is then BACKFILLED from the same policy - the selector is asked for a longer ranked list and its next eligible picks are taken. A short batch is never padded with random draws. A batch that still cannot fill is reported short, and the round metrics carry backfill_attempts, backfill_added and selection_source so a reader can see which measurements came from where

backfill.source: the arm's own policy, asked for a longer ranked list
backfill.note: Before this was implemented every baseline measured exactly 125 unique variants while our arms did not (GB1 reliability mean 123.23 / min 120, GB1 frontier mean 124.02 / min 107, TrpB frontier mean 120.23 / min 116), because proposals outside the eligible universe were rejected and never replaced. That under-filling biased AGAINST our arms. Per-round fill is recorded in round_metrics.csv.

seeding.sampler: random.Random(seed).sample(eligible_variant_ids, initial_size); the eligible list is sorted lexicographically, so the draw is reproducible

panoptes_default / panoptes_muse exercise production planning, selection and (live only) reflection. Gatekeeper authorisation and Modal ESM-2 execution are not exercised, because Orchestrator.run_stream() has no interface for substituting an experimental assay for ESM scoring in step 5.

panoptes_default plans from the target's annotated active sites (metadata.binding_positions), not from a per-target script. It deliberately does NOT use workers.mock_workers.MockLLMWorker, whose TrpB branch hardcodes positions 183/184/227/228 and suggests three of the four global-optimum residues - that would encode the answer this benchmark measures the discovery of.

panoptes_muse is given this library's saturated positions as its assayable scope, which is enforced deterministically on the planner's output. Without it the planner proposed distal allosteric residues the four-site library cannot measure and whole rounds were discarded as not_in_eligible_universe. Check the accepted/requested columns in round_metrics.csv: a short batch still means proposals were rejected.
